title: Intent
description: Complete desired execution state for one Workstream, per docs/specs/reconciliation/001_intent.md. Shape only: catalogue membership of harness, model, effort and capabilities is validated against the reviewed CatalogueView at authoring time (on Intents only), not by this schema.

power.description: Whether a live execution footprint should exist.

harness.description: One harness_id from the reviewed catalogue selecting one digest-pinned trusted image.

capabilities.description: Complete set of named capabilities requested for execution, possibly empty; compiled to exact OneCLI grants.

model.description: Exactly one model id the harness definition advertises.

effort.description: Exactly one effort level valid for the selected model.

persona.description: Frozen at default until an effective application/readback contract is registered.
